# Flow vocabulary attribution
The word/frequency pairs in flow-words.json are adapted from Hermit Dave's FrequencyWords English 2018 list, based on OpenSubtitles 2018.
Source: https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords/blob/master/content/2018/en/en_50k.txt
Project: https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords
Corpus: https://opus.nlpl.eu/OpenSubtitles2018.php
Content license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ (full text beside this notice).
Changes by Relay: retain the first 20,000 lowercase English tokens matching letters and optional internal apostrophe, and convert frequency pairs to JSON. This adapted vocabulary is distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. No source recordings or subtitle sentences are included.
